RANDOM FOREST · VISUAL OVERVIEW

Many trees, one combined prediction.

Each tree learns from a slightly different view of the dataset. The forest brings their results together.

questions.stem: Machine Learningలో Random Forest అంటే ఏమిటి? One Decision Tree బదులు Many Different Trees Predictions Combine చేసి Reliability ఎలా Improve చేస్తుంది?
options: Random Forest One Large Tree Train చేసి Every Prediction తర్వాత Only That Tree Change చేస్తుంది.
Forest Diverse Trees Predictions Combine చేసి Individual Tree Mistakes Reduce చేయవచ్చు.

questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Random Forest Many Decision Treesని Train చేసి వారి Answers Combine చేస్తుంది. ఒక Tree Mistake మొత్తం Resultని Control చేయకూడదు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Random Forest Bagged Decision Tree Ensemble. Each Tree Bootstrap Sample, Random Split Featuresతో Learn చేస్తుంది. Aggregation Variance Reduce చేయవచ్చు, but Every Datasetపై Better Accuracy Guarantee లేదు.

The final prediction often becomes more reliable when individual tree errors differ.

questions.stem: Random Forest Ensemble Learning ఎందుకు? Classificationలో Voting, Regressionలో Averaging Predictions ఎలా Combine అవుతాయి?

questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Classificationలో Trees Different Classes Support చేస్తాయి. Regressionలో Numeric Estimates Average చేస్తాం.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Classification Intuitive Majority Vote; Scikit-learn RandomForestClassifier Actually Tree Class Probabilities Average చేసి Highest Probability Class Choose చేస్తుంది. Regression Tree Numeric Predictions Arithmetic Mean.
questions.figure:
Classification chooses a class; regression predicts a number

Voting is the simple intuition; the implementation may average class probabilities.

questions.stem: Bootstrap Sampling, Bagging, Random Feature Selection ద్వారా Different Trees Grow చేసి Correlation, Variance ఎలా Reduce చేస్తాం?

Every Treeకి One Permanent Feature Select చేసి All Remaining Features Ignore చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Each Tree Different Training Rows, Some Featuresతో Learn చేస్తుంది. Variety వల్ల One Tree Mistakes Others Repeat చేసే Chance తగ్గవచ్చు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Bootstrap Rows With Replacement Sample చేస్తుంది; Some Rows Repeat, Others OOB Remain. Random Feature Subsets at Splits Trees Correlation Reduce, Bagging Average Variance Reduce చేయవచ్చు.
questions.figure:
Bootstrap samples and random feature choices make trees different

Trees are trained with replacement sampling, then consider random feature subsets at each split.

questions.figure:
Split, fit, predict, and evaluate with Scikit-learn

Show verified Python example
from sklearn.datasets import load_breast_cancer
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split

X, y = load_breast_cancer(return_X_y=True)
X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y, random_state=42
)
forest = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=100, max_depth=8, max_features="sqrt",
    oob_score=True, n_jobs=-1, random_state=42
)
forest.fit(X_tr, y_tr)
pred = forest.predict(X_te)
print("accuracy:", round(accuracy_score(y_te, pred), 3))
print("precision:", round(precision_score(y_te, pred), 3))
print("recall:", round(recall_score(y_te, pred), 3))
print("OOB score:", round(forest.oob_score_, 3))
print("feature importances:", forest.feature_importances_[:3])

Tune with validation or cross-validation. Keep the test split for final evaluation, not parameter selection.

questions.stem: Out-of-Bag (OOB) Error, Gini/Entropy, Permutation Importance, SHAP Features Explain చేయడంలో ఎలా Help చేస్తాయి? Imbalanced Data, Correlated Features Limitations?
options: OOB, Feature Importance Scores Each Feature Causal Effect Perfectly Prove చేస్తాయి.
Gini, Entropy Direct Feature Correlations Only Measure చేసి Performance Ignore చేస్తాయి.
Permutation Importance Correlated Featuresపై Never Change అవుతుంది; Imbalance No Effect.
OOB Unused Samples Tests; Impurity Splits; Importance Explains with Caveats చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: OOB Left-Out Examplesతో Estimate; Gini/Entropy Splits Evaluate; Importance Tools Explain చేస్తాయి—Causality Prove కావు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. OOB Individual Tree Bootstrapలో Excluded Rowsపై Predictions Aggregate. Gini/Entropy Split Impurity; Permutation Importance Feature Shuffleతో Metric Change; SHAP Attribution Estimates. Correlated Features, Class Imbalance Scores Mislead చేయవచ్చు.
questions.figure:
OOB, impurity, permutation scores, and SHAP explain different things

Correlated features may hide each other's importance; accuracy can miss minority-class mistakes.

questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Random Forest Trees Mostly Independent, Parallel; Gradient Boosted Models Sequentially New Trees Fit చేసి Errors Correct చేస్తాయి. XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost Different Optimizations Use. Production Benchmark CPU, Memory, Latency, Quality.
questions.figure:
Forests train independently; boosting corrects errors in stages

Boosting can outperform on some datasets, but costs and hyperparameter sensitivity depend on the setup.
